papers.title: Multi-omics analysis identifies CD48 and ITIH5 as potential diagnostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets for metabolic disorders associated with obesity.
papers.summary: Integrating single-cell and bulk RNA-seq of human white adipose tissue, this study identifies fibroblasts as key communication hubs in obesity-driven remodeling. Machine learning refined two biomarkers, CD48 and ITIH5, which distinguished obese from non-obese individuals (AUC 0.82/0.81), were elevated in obese mice and palmitate-treated adipocytes, and linked to immune infiltration and ECM remodeling, with docking-predicted drug candidates.

papers.title: Roles of m(6)A erasers FTO and ALKBH5 in drug resistance of hepatocellular carcinoma: mechanisms and clinical implications.
papers.summary: This review summarizes how the m6A erasers FTO and ALKBH5 drive drug resistance in hepatocellular carcinoma. By post-transcriptionally regulating key transcripts, they promote metabolic reprogramming, anti-apoptotic signaling, cancer stem cell maintenance, and immune suppression. The authors position FTO/ALKBH5 as dynamic biomarkers of treatment response and their small-molecule inhibitors as a strategy to overcome resistance.

papers.title: Lower expression of BRCA1 in cardiomyoblast alters the expression of apoptotic, inflammatory and metabolic pathway genes, and enhances catecholamine-induced hypertrophic response.
papers.summary: Using BRCA1-knockdown H9c2 cardiomyoblasts, this study shows BRCA1 loss alters apoptotic gene expression, downregulates inflammatory and metabolic genes, and upregulates hypertrophic genes. Isoproterenol-induced hypertrophy revealed further enhanced hypertrophic and fibrotic gene changes, indicating heightened stress responsiveness. The results support physiological BRCA1 expression as protective against maladaptive cardiac remodeling under stress stimuli.

papers.title: Apabetalone mediates HIV-1 transcriptional activation and clearance of latently infected cells via LncRNA OSER1-AS1.
papers.summary: In latently HIV-1-infected Jurkat (J-Lat 10.6) and PBMC models, apabetalone activated viral transcription, increased G0/G1 arrest, and induced apoptosis while downregulating MYC and p-RB and upregulating Tat and p21. Silencing the lncRNA OSER1-AS1 blunted these effects, indicating apabetalone promotes Tat-CDK9 binding and latency reversal via OSER1-AS1 upregulation.

papers.title: SDP-ChroNet: A shared dilated pooling network for chromatin interaction prediction.
papers.summary: SDP-ChroNet is a deep learning framework for predicting chromatin interactions that addresses severe class imbalance in such data. Using a shared residual dilated unit to capture local motifs and long-range dependencies plus genomic features, it outperformed state-of-the-art methods across multiple datasets and introduced a method to quantify conditionally shared genomic feature effects across cellular contexts.

papers.title: NGS-Guided Discovery of Cross-Reactive TfR1 VHH Antibodies with Distinct Brain Localization Profiles.
papers.summary: Combining phage display with NGS-guided selection after alpaca immunization against human and rat transferrin receptor 1, researchers isolated three cross-reactive VHH antibodies reformatted as human Fc fusions. In mice, clone Y11 showed sustained brain fluorescence localizing to neurons, while A1 localized to vasculature, identifying distinct BBB-crossing profiles useful for compartment-selective CNS drug delivery.
